title: ZOZO customer data leak via PLAID KARTE, Nov 2026
disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by ZOZO, PLAID, JINS, MUFG Bank, RIZAP, Optage, KOSE, Nikkei, CNET Japan, NHK, ITmedia, Yomiuri Shimbun or any other company, news outlet, government agency, or anyone else named.
size_basis: About 15.18 million ZOZOTOWN users and 13.93 million WEAR users, per ZOZO. The two groups overlap by an unpublished amount. The same vendor breach hit hundreds of other companies.
who_is_affected: ZOZOTOWN and WEAR by ZOZO users, including former ZOZOTOWN members, and current and former staff of brands on ZOZOTOWN. Leaked: member ID, age, gender, postal code; for about 47,000, also display name, email and phone. Passwords were not, per ZOZO. Expect fake emails and texts.

known.text: An outside party got into PLAID's KARTE service on Nov 13, and ZOZO data held there leaked.
About 15.18M ZOZOTOWN users (former members too) had member ID, age, gender and postal code leaked.
About 13.93M WEAR users and about 24,000 brand staff were also hit.
Passwords were not exposed, per ZOZO.
PLAID says the intrusion hit many other companies, and KARTE has been off since Nov 13.

not_known.text: Whether the data has been used against people, or whether more was taken.
Whether PLAID's account of the method holds up to independent review.
